$comment: The four cases /healthz has to answer, pinned to values instead of to whatever commit happens to be checked out. Every sha here is synthetic hexadecimal; none of them is a commit in this repository, and nothing in this file is customer or operational data.

matchingRelease.$comment: The abbreviated sha a person copies out of `git log`, against the full 40 the build stamped. Same commit, two lengths — this is the prefix rule the module exists for.
matchingRelease.title: Queue drain

olderRelease.$comment: Older than both of the above, so a log holding it plus one of them proves the newest record is the one compared.
olderRelease.title: Structured logs
olderRelease.description: Log every request with a request id.
